create_ManagedAttribute_with_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that enforces a specific type when setting values on a class
create_ManagedAttribute_without_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that allows any type when setting values on a class
use_ManagedAttribute_get: use the ManagedAttribute descriptor to get the private backing value of a managed class attribute
use_ManagedAttribute_set: use the ManagedAttribute descriptor to set a value on a class attribute with optional type enforcement
review_ManagedAttribute: review the ManagedAttribute descriptor class and its type enforcement logic for Runner and Reducer components
